create_chat_role_factory: create a ChatRoleFactory to distribute chat role generation across multiple model endpoints
generate_next_turn: generate the next chat turn by sending messages to an LLM endpoint via aiohttp
apply_chat_template: apply a chat template to convert message lists into system user assistant format
generate_completion: generate text completions by appending a prompt to chat turns and sending to a completion endpoint
generate_next_turn_candidates: generate multiple candidate chat turns in parallel using the Matrix client or legacy HTTP endpoint
